reason: The documentary mechanism is valid, but the strongest admissible expression requires reproducible historical prices for both entitlement-bearing and non-entitlement-bearing claims. For the clean Gentherm THRM/THRMV event, Nasdaq documents THRMV and its when-issued entitlement semantics, but its historical page reports data unavailable. Other discovered public surfaces expose at most isolated last-price/volume metadata, not a reproducible historical series suitable for a frozen parity test.

source_findings.finding: Quote surface currently unavailable for historical reconstruction.
Only isolated last-close information discovered; insufficient for reproducible multi-date parity reconstruction.
Volume/listing metadata discovered, but no usable historical price series.

scientific_scope: This is not an economic rejection. It only parks the candidate until a reproducible point-in-time price source for both legs is available. The due-bill legal mechanism remains documentary-validated.
next_action: Rotate to another independently qualified candidate without converting Due Bill into a confounded ordinary-stock directional test.
